# Udixio UI

> Udixio UI is a component library for React, Angular and Svelte, built on Material 3. Its animation runtime is @udixio/motion, which is framework-agnostic.

The component and data pages are also available as markdown: append `.md` to their URL. Insert `.react`, `.angular` or `.svelte` before `.md` to get one framework only, for example https://ui.udixio.fr/components/switch.react.md. The motion pages are HTML pages; use the motion manifest below for the exact names.

## Motion

- [Motion overview](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion): what @udixio/motion does, need by need, with a live example of each.
- [Getting started](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/getting-started): install, connect the runtime once, attach a motion by name.
- [Presets and verbs](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/presets): defineMotion, the seven verbs and the presets.
- [Show and hide](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/presence): entries and exits, the hidden attribute, focus restoration.
- [Make a list appear](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/lists): cascades, stagger, origin and exit of a list.
- [Draw attention](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/emphasis): replays on each change of state.
- [Move to a new place](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/layout): layout motions, resize, scopes and play().
- [Morph one into another](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/shared-elements): elements that share a key travel from one to the other.
- [Drag, swipe, reorder](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/gestures): drag, swipe and reorder, with their keyboard alternatives.
- [Change pages](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/page-transitions): navigate() and the Astro client router, with the direction.
- [Reveal on scroll](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/reveal): motions that play when an element enters the view.
- [Link to the scroll](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/scrub): motions driven by the scroll position.
- [Scroll to a target](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/scroll): scrollTo over a spring.
- [Follow pointer or state](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/values): continuous values written as CSS variables.
- [Count a number](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/counters): formatted counters, locale and accessible text.
- [Choreograph steps](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/sequences): named steps of one root, with one handle.
- [Animate text](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/text): split by words, characters or lines.
- [Draw or morph SVG](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/svg): drawing, travelling along a path, morphing.
- [Loop, and pause it](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/loop): endless motions and the rules that pause them.
- [Springs and tokens](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/tokens): springs, durations, easings, distances and the document scale.
- [Per breakpoint](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/scopes): motion per breakpoint, revert and inspect.
- [Animate any CSS](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/animate): animateStyle, createSpring and their helpers.
- [Reduced motion](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/accessibility): the reduced-motion policy and what each verb shows under it.
- [Limits](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/limits): the current limits, family by family.
- [Motion manifest](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion-manifest.json): the machine-readable contract of the package, as JSON. It lists the verbs, their options and domains, the presets with their keyframes, the tokens, and each entry of the package with its public exports. Read it before you write a motion definition, and do not use a name it does not list.

## Components

- [Components catalog](https://ui.udixio.fr/components.md): every component, with its slug, category, status and frameworks.
- [AI agents](https://ui.udixio.fr/agents): how to connect an agent to Udixio UI.

## Optional

- [Roadmap](https://ui.udixio.fr/motion/roadmap): the status of the families.
